name: 예영

tips.단·복수: many, there are 뒤에는 복수형(-s). clothes는 항상 복수예요.
tips.주어-동사: he/she/it/the city → has, is. people → are, love. 동사는 하나만!
tips.동사·시제: 진행형은 be + -ing, 과거 질문엔 과거형, 부정은 don't / doesn't.
tips.문장 구조: 한 문장에 동사는 하나! need to / have to 뒤에는 동사, 명사는 바로 need / have.
tips.관사·전치사: 처음 말하는 집은 a house, 바다는 the beach. go on holiday, on a rainy day.
tips.품사: be 뒤에는 형용사: confident, dead, scary, active.
tips.단어 선택: 한국어를 그대로 옮기지 말고 영어에서 쓰는 짝꿍 표현으로.
tips.발음·철자: walk(r 소리 없음) / work(r 소리). 철자는 소리 내어 한 번 더.

What's going on? Why is it so noisy?

cards.gram: 휴가를 가다는 go on holiday로 통째로 외워요. 끝에 a few days ago(며칠 전)가 있으니 동사는 과거형 went예요.
해변, 바다, 산처럼 모두가 아는 장소 앞에는 the: the beach, the sea, the mountains. 내 이야기니까 주어는 I.
have a sweet tooth는 관용 표현이라 동사는 like가 아니라 have, 앞에 a도 꼭!
한 문장에 동사는 하나만! is와 love를 같이 쓰면 안 돼요. people은 복수라 be동사라면 are.
affect는 동사(영향을 주다), effect는 명사(영향). 주어가 3인칭 단수라 affects.
doesn't = does not. 여기서 matter는 '중요하다'라는 동사. 내 입장이니까 to me.

cards.en: I went to Hawaii six months ago.
cards.gram: ago 전에 · for 6 months 동안 · in 6 months 후에. 모르는 단어도 영어로: Hawaii.

noise(명사) → noisy(형용사). be동사 뒤에는 형용사! 과거 이야기라 was.

ideas.topic: Describe one of your friends who learned something without a teacher
points: 누구, 무엇을 배웠나
My friend Jisoo taught herself to play the guitar.
어떻게 배웠나
She watched YouTube videos and practised for 30 minutes every day.
어려웠던 점
At first it was hard because nobody corrected her mistakes.
내 느낌
I really admire her because she stuck to a routine and never gave up.
part3: Why do some people prefer to learn things by themselves rather than from a teacher?
Do you think self-learning is more difficult than learning with a teacher? Why?
Are there any disadvantages to learning without professional guidance?
Is self-learning more common among young people today than in the past?
Do you think schools should teach students how to learn independently?

ideas.topic: Describe an environmental law you would like your country to introduce
points: 어떤 법
I'd like Korea to ban single-use plastic cups in cafés.
어떻게 작동하나
Cafés would have to use reusable cups, and the government would impose fines on shops that break the rule.
왜 필요한가
We use a huge amount of plastic every day, and most of it isn't recycled.
기대 효과
It would cut down on plastic waste and raise environmental awareness.
part3: What is the biggest environmental problem in your country?
What should individuals be doing to protect the natural environment?
How could government help prevent pollution?
Do you think young people today are more aware of environmental problems?
Do you think it's important to protect trees?

ideas.topic: Describe a piece of technology that you would like to own
points: 무엇
I'd love to own a robot vacuum cleaner.
무슨 기능
It cleans the floor by itself while I'm out, and I can control it with an app.
왜 갖고 싶나
I'm always busy, so cleaning takes up a lot of my free time.
생활이 어떻게 바뀔까
It would save me time, so I could spend more time on yoga or reading.
expr: save me a lot of time
part3: How has technology changed people's daily lives?
How has technology changed the way people communicate with each other?
Should schools encourage students to use more technology in the classroom?
Why do some people always want to buy the latest technology?

ideas.topic: Describe a live sports event you watched and liked
points: 무엇, 언제, 어디서
Last summer I watched a baseball game at Jamsil Stadium in Seoul.
누구와
I went with a few friends from work.
분위기
The atmosphere was electric. Everyone was singing and cheering.
왜 좋았나
It was a nail-biting game, and our team won in the last inning.
expr: on the edge of my seat
part3: What qualities do successful athletes usually have?
Do you think children should be encouraged to play sports from a young age?
Do you think hosting major sporting events is beneficial for a country?
Do you think watching sports can bring people together?

ideas.topic: Describe a perfect job you would like to have in the future
points: 어떤 직업
My perfect job would be a yoga instructor.
무슨 일을 하나
I would teach classes and help people stay healthy and relaxed.
필요한 능력
You need patience, good communication skills, and a lot of practice.
왜 완벽한가
I feel I'm in my element when I do yoga, so it wouldn't feel like work.
part3: What factors do people usually consider when choosing a career?
Do you think young people today change jobs more often than in the past?
Is it more important to earn a high salary or to enjoy your job?
How do you think technology will change the workplace in the future?

ideas.topic: Describe a person you know who has a successful business
points: 누구, 어떤 사업
My aunt runs her own bakery in my hometown.
어떻게 시작했나
She started it from scratch about ten years ago.
왜 성공했나
Her bread is amazing, and she remembers every customer's name, so it spread by word of mouth.
내 느낌
I really look up to her because she works so hard.
part3: Do you think small businesses are important for the economy?
Why do some businesses become successful while others fail?
Should young people be encouraged to start their own businesses?
Is customer service important for a successful business?

ideas.topic: Describe a place you have travelled to that you would like to recommend to others
points: 어디, 언제
A few years ago I visited Da Nang in Vietnam.
어떤 곳
It has beautiful beaches and the food is cheap and delicious.
무엇을 했나
I swam in the sea, tried local street food, and visited a famous tourist attraction, the Marble Mountains.
왜 추천하나
It's relaxing and affordable, so it's perfect for a short holiday.
part3: Do you think people travel more nowadays than in the past?
What kinds of places do people in your country like to visit?
What are the main reasons people choose to travel abroad?
Is it better to travel alone or with other people?

ideaTip: Part 2는 1분 준비 → 2분 말하기. 첫 문장으로 무엇인지 말하고 → 말할 거리 3~4가지 → 내 느낌으로 마무리해요.
